_comment: AGENT/HUMAN-OWNED profile content. generate-profile-readme.py renders dlorp/dlorp's README from this file — it never invents badge values or a banner. Edit badges/banner/copy here; the daily workflow redeploys. The banner IMAGE (hdls-banner.png) is pinned in dlorp/dlorp and is NOT deployed by the workflow. Badge tuples are [label, message, color, alt]; label "" means a message-only badge.
intro: A signal chain research collective. We build local AI infrastructure with synapse-engine,
off-grid mesh networks with myc3lium, and preserve vanishing knowledge with dr3dg3-n3t.
Everything runs on hardware we own — no cloud, no keys.

flagship.name: synapse-engine
flagship.desc: Distributed orchestration platform for local language models. Multi-tier LLM orchestration runs entirely on local hardware — no API keys required. v5.1.0.

flagship.name: myc3lium
flagship.desc: Resilient off-grid mesh communication lattice. Triple-radio mesh (LoRa, WiFi HaLow, 802.11s), encrypted LXMF messaging, ATAK integration, live sensor feeds. Field-ready, operator-centric. v0.10.0.

flagship.name: dr3dg3-n3t
flagship.desc: Offline internet — a "Web 3.0 Whole Earth Catalog" for preserving knowledge that matters. Curated snapshots of vanishing sources, structured for browsing without a connection.

other_projects.name: r3LAY
other_projects.desc: Local-first project brain — natural language queries over project docs and notes, no cloud. 2371 tests passing. v0.13.0.

other_projects.name: phase-engine
other_projects.desc: Circadian awareness tool for Sensor Watch — four natural phases, intelligent feedback. Bangle.js 2 for testing, f91W custom firmware is the target

other_projects.name: t3rra1n
other_projects.desc: HDLS Procedural Generation Toolkit — terrain, noise, signal-chain aesthetics, PS1 rendering shaders. ARG component: field reports from a stranded HDLS researcher documenting alien landscapes. v0.2.1.

other_projects.name: heedless.net
other_projects.desc: Personal site with HDLS amber CRT aesthetic — VT323 typography, #ff9500 palette, pure HTML/CSS/JS. No frameworks. v1.0.0.

other_projects.name: knowledge-vault
other_projects.desc: 6830 entries across 153 domains — the collective memory

other_projects.name: vault-crawler
other_projects.desc: Personal knowledge acquisition engine — crawls web, PDFs, forums, GitHub, RSS, media. 150 tests passing. v0.3.0.

other_projects.name: openclaw-dash
other_projects.desc: Hermes Agent monitoring cockpit — Textual TUI, plugin architecture, MQTT sink for ESP32/OLED panels. v0.4.0.
